title: Pumpkin Bridge mod index
description: mod-index.json: written by the Gradle build in mod/ and read by the launcher. Node ids, file names and (loader, minecraft) cells must be unique. Strategy mappings are fabricAddMods for Fabric, quiltAddMods for explicit Quilt artifacts (no Fabric fallback), fmlMavenRoot for older Forge/NeoForge, fmlModFolders for NeoForge only, and forgeClasspath for modern Forge only. A node without a verified entry is switched off.

modVersion.description: The launcher version the jars were built for. Used as a folder name.

plainName.description: One path segment: starts with a letter or digit, then letters, digits and . _ + -, at most 128 characters.

releaseId.description: An explicit Mojang release id such as 1.21.1 or 26.3. Never a range, a snapshot, a pre-release or a release candidate.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD with month 01 through 12 and day 01 through 31, matching the launcher; calendar existence is not checked.

smoke.description: Day the headless smoke test of this node passed.

owner.description: Day the owner checked this cell by hand, or null.

id.description: Unique plain node id, independent of generator naming. Conventionally <minecraft range>-<loader>, for example 1.21.1-neoforge.

loaderMin.description: Smallest loader version that runs the jar (Fabric loader, Quilt loader, NeoForge, Forge). Compared numerically as unsigned 64-bit components; a suffix after the digits is ignored.

strategy.description: Loader-specific injection strategy. Quilt requires its own explicit artifact and loader.addMods; forgeClasspath is for modern Forge, never NeoForge.

file.description: Plain leaf file name of the jar. Unique per node.

verified.description: Absent or null: the cell is off.
